An '''orbital security station''' monitored [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] traffic on and off worlds during the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were stationed on worlds including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. People were employed to operate the stations, [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] sponsored the ones [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] that world. The [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] workers also reported to [[Coruscant Control]].
